module: Transforms a mission vehicle filter configuration (filterData: whitelist/blacklist, probability settings, manual additions and removals, maxVehicles) into a flat list of model/configuration pairs. Relies on util/configListGenerator to get the eligible vehicles.

hasAnyConfiguration.desc: Indicates whether filterData contains a real constraint: non-empty whitelist or blacklist, probabilitySettings, manualAdditions, manualRemovals or maxVehicles > 0.

filterData.desc: Filter data; any non-table gives false.

returns.desc: true if the filter constrains the vehicle set.

resolveFilteredConfigs.desc: Resolves filterData into a list {model, config, name}. Applies the base filter, the probabilitySettings (which replace the result if they find vehicles), the maxVehicles limit, the manual removals ('model/config' keys), then adds the manual additions not already present, without duplicates. allowAuxiliaryVehicles and allowLoadedTrailers control eligibility.

filterData.desc: Fields read: allowAuxiliaryVehicles, allowLoadedTrailers, baseFilter, probabilitySettings, maxVehicles, manualRemovals, manualAdditions.

returns.desc: List of {model = string, config = string, name = string} (empty if filterData is not a table).
